checks: Long meeting initial snapshot and live duration/level/partial/status in runtime-only reply
Local note write and another SQLite connection refresh the saved data
Different meeting and deleted meeting cannot reuse a previous reply
Mounted Chromium verifies pause and duration, notes status, unchanged editor and history, changed partial, caption fallback and stale reply after a meeting switch
limitations: The byte measurement is JSON payload at the actual Rust poll result, not a CPU, latency or power benchmark.
Main meeting shell only. Background scheduler and floating transcript window still use their existing snapshot paths. The renderer rechecks rows if the live partial changes.
